notes.title: Wordies - Update 0.16
notes.content:
[h1][b]Wordies v0.16 has arrived![/b][/h1]

And that means Wordies is now available to the general public! We hope you enjoy your time playing the project we've spent hours working on.

 [h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Refined global leaderboards
[*]  Changed fonts
[*]  Altered Button Appearances
[*]  Added Main Menu
[*]  Renamed regular mode to 'freeplay'
[*]  Added button for new mode called 'Hangman' (coming soon)
[*]  Improved animations and set playthrough rate to 60 fps
[*]  Added discord rich presence
[*]  Added real time clock to update daily word universally
[*]  Improved general flow of UI
[/list]

 [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Confirmation prompt now always shows when going from freeplay to daily word while in a game
[*]  When completing the daily word, your streaks & stats are no longer effected
[*]  Load up animation has been refined to allow for API connections before interacting with the game
[/list]

 Enjoy, and welcome to Wordies!

notes.title: Wordies - Update 0.14
notes.content:
[h1][b]Wordies v0.14 has arrived![/b][/h1]

 [h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Added Global Leaderboards
[*]  Changed Stats & Leaderboards button tooltip
[*]  Highest personal score is automatically uploaded to Leaderboards
[*]  Added underline transform transitions when entering a guess
[*]  Added underline transform transitions when beginning a new round
[*]  Removed Good luck text when beginning a new round
[*]  Minor UI changes
[/list]

 [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Keyboard keys now display correct colour corresponding to the letters guessed
[*]  Personal Stats are now displayed instantly when ending & beginning rounds
[*]  Winstreak stat is now calculated correctly and instantenously
[/list]

 Enjoy!

notes.title: Wordies - Update 0.13
notes.content:
[h1][b]Wordies v0.13 has arrived![/b][/h1]

 [h2]Features[/h2]
 [list]
 [*] Added a personal stats screen which tracks highest win streak, rounds played, 
 rounds won & win percentage.
 [*] Personal Stats now save on closing the game & reopening it.
 [*] You can now use your keyboard to type alongside the current point & click controls.
 [*] Game size has been dramatically decreased.
 [/list]

 [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
 [list]
 [*] Winstreak is now set to 0 when giving up or pressing the exit button.
 [*] Personal stats automatically loaded up upon launching the game.
 [*] Fixed odd anomalies when dealing with two letters in the same word.
 [/list]

 Enjoy!
